title: Priority, urgency and service level agreements (SLA)

videos.script: Ten tickets are open, and you can work on one. Which one? {{ten}} Not the loudest, not the most senior person's, and not the oldest by default. Priority comes from two questions: how much is affected, and how fast it gets worse. {{two}} Then the service level agreement turns priority into time: how soon somebody answers, and how soon it should be solved. {{sla}} This lesson puts both into practice, including the part that surprises everybody: a ticket opened on Friday afternoon, and the clock that stops for the weekend. {{friday}}
